annotations.title: A baby name in every US state

description: Where in the US is a first name most popular? The name's count and rank in every state and territory for one year, and the state where its share is highest. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

name.description: A first name as SSA spells it: 2-15 letters A-Z, any case ("olivia" works). Spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are dropped like SSA drops them ("Mary-Kate" → "Marykate"). Accents are read as plain letters ("Sofía" finds "Sofia").

sex.description: F or M, as recorded by SSA. Leave out for both.

year.description: Year, 1910 or later (territories from 1998). Default: the latest year with state data for this name.
